data.content:
I sent four disputes for your approval, and there is one case I need a ticket photo for. The next deadline is 2026-11-24, in 10 days.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win probability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-48290 | $27.40 | 90% (strong) | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Protein Bowl. The order was ready at 17:35 and picked up at 17:39. |
| DD-48251 | $21.00 | 77% (moderate) | The ticket lists Chia Pudding. Ready 19:15, picked up 19:18. |
| DD-48230 | $18.75 | 80% (moderate) | The ticket lists Green Smoothie. Ready 13:24, picked up 13:29. |
| DD-48267 | $16.50 | 90% (evidence rated moderate) | The ticket lists Peanut Butter Bowl. Ready 12:52, picked up 12:55. |

- **Past results:** In the stored history, 2 of 3 similar missing-item disputes were won. The one loss involved a side item that wasn't itemised on the ticket.
- **DD-48251:** This is a wrong-item claim, and there are no past cases to compare it with.
- **DD-48267:** The computed score is higher than the evidence supports. I kept the tool's number and did not adjust it.
- **What the tickets show:** A ticket shows what was prepared, not what was packed. The disputes state only facts and say nothing about the customer.
- **Repeat claims:** DD-48244, DD-48251 and DD-48267 come from the same account in this period. That count is not mentioned in the disputes.

**Weak, needs your input**
- **DD-48211 ($42.00):** No order ticket is on file, so the win probability fell from 60% to 35%. Please send a photo of the ticket for this order. It is the largest deduction, and I'll re-check it once I have the photo.

**Not investigated yet**
- DD-48244 ($14.25, 60%) and DD-48280 ($9.50, 60%) were outside the top 5, so I haven't checked their evidence. I can do that next.

**Skip**
- DD-48301 ($12.00) has a 15% win probability, so it isn't worth your time.
- DD-47990 is a $0.00 deduction and its deadline has passed.

The case notes are in `/plan.md`. Once DoorDash decides, tell me the result of each dispute and I'll record it.
